description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the 'ModifyFeatureDefinition' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages updating or creating feature definitions for 'Thing' entities, generating corresponding events and responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy to handle 'ModifyFeatureDefinition' commands, managing feature definition updates or creation, and generating corresponding events and responses.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command logic: extracts the feature from the 'Thing', then either modifies or creates the feature definition, returning the result.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specific feature from the 'Thing' based on the feature ID in the command.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to modify an existing feature definition or create a new one, based on the presence of a definition.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Constructs a result representing a modified feature definition event and response.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Constructs a result representing a created feature definition event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous feature definition, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the new feature definition from the command.
